title: What Would You Do? — A Radio Phone-In
title_ar: إنت كنت هتعمل إيه؟ — برنامج مداخلات
gist_ar: برنامج مداخلات: لو لقيت شنطة فيها فلوس كتير، هتعمل إيه؟ اتنين ردّوا بطريقتين مختلفتين.

before_listening.en: A radio phone-in with two callers. They reach the same decision for very different reasons. Listen for what they AGREE on.
before_listening.ar: برنامج مداخلات في الراديو مع متصلين. الاتنين وصلوا لنفس القرار بأسباب مختلفة. ركّز على إيه اللي متفقين عليه.

segments.speaker: Host
segments.text: Good afternoon. Today's question is simple. If you found a bag with a lot of money in it, what would you do? The lines are open. First caller, you are on.

segments.speaker: Hisham
segments.text: Hello. I would take it straight to the police. I know some people would keep it, but I would not sleep. If it were my bag, I would want somebody to do the same for me. My father lost his wallet in a taxi twenty years ago, and a stranger returned it with everything inside. If that had not happened, I think I would be a different person today.

segments.speaker: Dina
segments.text: I would take it to the police too, but I want to be honest: I would think about it first. If I had no money for the rent that month, it would be much harder. I do not think people who keep it are all bad. I think they are frightened. If we talked about money more openly, fewer people would be in that situation.

segments.speaker: Host
segments.text: Two answers, and neither of them is as simple as it sounds. More after the news.

gist_question.q: What do the two callers agree about?
gist_question.q_ar: إيه اللي المتصلين الاتنين متفقين عليه؟
options: That they would take the bag to the police
That everyone who keeps the money is a bad person
That they would keep the money if the rent was due

questions.q: Why does Hisham say he would return it?
options: Because a stranger once returned his father's wallet
Because he is afraid of the police
Because he has never needed money
That she would keep the money
That she would think about it first
That she has kept money before

questions.q: What does Dina say would help?
